logp.method_description: The partition coefficient of porphyrins was determined using a mixture of n-octanol (3.0 mL) and water (3.0 mL) as described according to the literature [30]. The partition coefficient was measured by UV–Vis analysis and the log POW values was calculated with Aorg and Aaq being the maximum absorbances of the Soret band in the organic and aqueous phases, and Vorg and Vaq being the final volumes of the organic and aqueous phases, respectively.
